scenarios.name: Launch a choice from a grouped command menu

background_steps.name: the MCAD Software starts with a writable copy of `fixtures/preferences/ribbon-normal` as its configuration directory

scenario_steps.name: `fixtures/cad/workspace-layout-native.opd` is open and active in the MCAD Software
a part is active in the MCAD Software
the 3D Model Work Features panel contains a grouped "Plane" command
the user opens the Plane drop-down and selects "Offset from Plane"
the software prompts the user to select a planar face
the user presses Escape without selecting a face
the software returns to the ready state
the grouped Plane control and the part remain visible
no new work plane is created
